title: TUI task detail drops reservation context and offers invalid close
description: Evidence: loadRepoTaskDetail builds a WorkItemView without reservationsByWorkId, while task-detail renders activeReservation and loaders.ts offers direct work close for in_progress/reserved work. apps/cli/src/commands/work.ts rejects direct close for actively reserved work. Impact: task detail can show reserved=no and offer a Close action that fails.
acceptanceCriteria: Task detail includes active reservation context and offers the reservation-aware finish/close command for owned reservations, with tests for reserved work detail actions.
